question_en: What are the narrative locations of the movie 2001 A space odyssey?
question_fr: Quels sont les lieux narratifs du film 2001, l'Odyssée de l'espace ?
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_ITEM.ID_WIKIDATA FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_WIKIDATA_ITEM_PROPERTY ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_WIKIDATA = T_WC_WIKIDATA_ITEM_PROPERTY.ID_WIKIDATA JOIN T_WC_T2S_ITEM ON T_WC_WIKIDATA_ITEM_PROPERTY.ID_ITEM = T_WC_T2S_ITEM.ID_WIKIDATA WHERE (T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.MOVIE_TITLE = '2001: A Space Odyssey' OR T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.MOVIE_TITLE_FR = '2001: A Space Odyssey' OR T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ORIGINAL_TITLE = '2001: A Space Odyssey') AND T_WC_WIKIDATA_ITEM_PROPERTY.ID_PROPERTY = 'P840' LIMIT 8
